headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Sets N15 Billion Capital Rule for Foreign Stablecoin Issuers
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria established a minimum paid-up capital of N15 billion for foreign currency-backed stablecoin issuers. The regulator also introduced stricter identity verification and approval requirements for peer-to-peer crypto transactions.
why: The Central Bank of Nigeria is the country's monetary authority, regulating banking and financial services in Africa's largest economy.
